title: Why I cancelled my $100 Claude Max plan for Cursor + Codex
description:
Rik cancelled his $100 Claude Max plan and split the spend across Cursor, Codex, Claude and Grok — a vibe coding cost breakdown every AI builder and indie hacker should see. Why one frontier model subscription rarely beats four cheaper AI tools.

More AI news and vibe coding takes on God Mode Pod — the AI podcast for builders. New episodes drop Saturday. Full episode → https://youtube.com/@godmodepod
